    <dc:creator opf:file-as="Whitehead, Colson" opf:role="aut">Colson Whitehead</dc:creator>
    <dc:contributor opf:role="bkp">calibre (9.13.0) [https://calibre-ebook.com]</dc:contributor>
    <dc:description><b>From #1 <i>New York Times </i>bestselling author and two-time Pulitzer winner Colson Whitehead, an exuberantly entertaining novel that brings to life 1980s New York in the magnificent final volume of his Harlem Trilogy</b><br>1981. New York City is beginning to emerge from financial ruin and&nbsp;decline, energized by rampant real estate development and a Wall&nbsp;Street unchained by Reagan-era predatory capitalism.&nbsp;Up in Harlem, successful business owner/master fence Ray Carney has just been named Sterling Furniture&rsquo;s Dealer of the Month. When the banks won&rsquo;t give his beloved wife Elizabeth a loan for her new travel agency, however, Carney gambles on one last heist, and finds himself entangled with a legendary criminal mastermind.<br>1983. To some, Carney&rsquo;s friend and partner in crime, Pepper, is a stone-cold sociopath. To others, a top thief with questionable people skills. Either way, he&rsquo;s feeling his&nbsp;age in his troubled gut and his aching...</dc:description>
